reflections.reflection: As Jony Ive, my life's work has been driven by design is not just how it looks, it's how it works.
I am known as a Chief Design Officer, but that label barely captures the complexity of what I do.
What drives me is simplicity is the ultimate sophistication. This has shaped every major decision I've made.
My worldview is shaped by the belief that every detail matters - care is visible.
When people look back at my work, I want them to understand that technology should disappear into the experience.
